Class HeadInfo

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.HeadInfo
public final class HeadInfo extends Object
Resolved view of one entity eye configuration after age and weighted placement-variant selection. Storage, selection, serialization, caching, and rendering transforms are owned by their respective domains; this class only exposes the selected heads and eyes to consumers.
